notes:
Fullobby 0.3.0

Sign-in is steadier: no more surprise re-logins, and the join-a-network
prompt no longer appears when you are already in a network. The offline
banner now only shows when you are actually offline.

Linking a Discord or Steam account now completes only after the account
confirms it, closing a window where a link could be started by someone else.

Admins get an Admin tab with the web panel built into the app.

Windows 11 is now required.

Also includes idle power and layout fixes, plus groundwork for per-network
seeding schedules.
